sentences.en: That general, Championnets successor, had been compelled by these reverses and by the threatening pressure of Nelsons fleet to evacuate Naples and central Italy.

sentences.en: The isolation of Bonaparte in Egypt, as the result Bonaparte of Nelsons victory of the Nile (1798), had enabled bftaks up the allies to recover some of the ground lost to France.
sentences.vi: Việc Bonaparte ở Ai Cập bị cô lập, kết quả là Bonaparte of Nelsons chiến thắng sông Nile (1798), đã tạo điều kiện cho quân đồng minh khôi phục lại một phần đất bị mất vào tay Pháp.

sentences.en: Unfortunately, Nelsons birthplace was demolished just after his father's death and replaced by the present rectory.

sentences.en: Unfortunately within a couple of years the Nelsons acquired a reputation for poor steaming.
